summary: Batch certification of four exploration maps: veracity split into confirming-is-asserting, sincerity and infallibility (Knows not factive by definition); the authority truth bridge from definitive-proposal confirmation (via assistance) plus veracity; revelation possible and recognizable from omnipotence (derived from GodIsInfinite through power-follows-act), noncontradiction, exclusive signs and an open analysis of the primitive RevealsRecognizably; reduced naming from operation naming and maximality of a universal cause of being. Controls: one joint finite witness of all premises and conclusions with a God that has the classical attributes, plus 11 omission models covering every premise of the four target-reaching steps. All new premises remain OPEN analyst formulations; no source attribution, no premise discharge.
blocker: Every new premise is open. Linking ClassicalAttributesIncludePerfectIntellectAndGoodWill to GodHasIntellect/GodHasWill, and RecognizableRevelationAnalysis to a typed account of signs, needs further vocabulary.
